query: Identify the key sentiment-bearing phrases in Instance A that indicate a positive review (e.g., '10/10', 'powerful message', 'heart wrenching material') and contrast them with the negative sentiment indicators in Instance B (e.g., 'not very bad', 'really bad', 'cannot succeed').
expected_output: A list of decisive positive tokens/phrases in Instance A and decisive negative tokens/phrases in Instance B, along with their approximate start/end indices.
